text: Architecture focuses on "architecture" as its core research object. Here, "architecture" not only refers to individual buildings (such as residences, museums, office buildings), but also includes the planning and design of building complexes, urban spaces, and regional landscapes. Core objective: By combining science and art, design a building space that not only meets the functional needs of human life, work, and culture, but also possesses aesthetic value, technical feasibility, and environmental adaptability. At the same time, it should also take into account the inheritance of historical context and the exploration of future lifestyles.Disciplinary attribute: It is a highly "interdisciplinary" discipline within the field of engineering, integrating knowledge from multiple domains such as art (form, color, proportion), engineering (structure, materials, mechanics), sociology (population behavior, community relations), history (architectural heritage protection), and ecology (green buildings, low-carbon design).
